sprint.title: One Hop-Count-Agnostic Sequential Local Destination Traversal
sprint.goal: Execute each resolved local movement hop as an authoritative completion before starting the next hop.
acceptance_criteria: Each completed movement hop is validated, has its derived scene rebuilt, and is published before the next hop.
A later hop failure preserves earlier authoritative completed hops.
Existing timed West Road movement and arrival consequences apply at the timed hop.
One-, two-, and three-hop behavior remains compatible; save version stays 1 and movement_hops remains transient.

focused_commands: Affected movement, navigation, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
The existing resolver remains the sole route representation and routes stay transient.
No persistence, migration, parser expansion, dynamic routing, interruption, narration, or excluded system is permitted.
Provider requests are forbidden and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: Official preflight, canonical record validation, syntax checks, focused sequential traversal coverage, timed West Road, navigation, save/load, narration-context, fake-transport provider-safe, and complete 39-script repository test inventory passed. No live provider request occurred. Save version remains 1 and next_sprint remains null.
